export type CacheTtl = '1h' | '5m'

export type CacheTtlOption = 'auto' | CacheTtl

export type WarmerConfig = {
  cacheTtl: CacheTtlOption
  // 0 means stop once pings cost as much as one cache rewrite.
  maxPings: number
  minContextTokens: number
}

export type StopReason =
  | 'budget-spent'
  | 'expired-before-ping'
  | 'cold-ping'
  | 'small-context'
  | 'nothing-to-fork'
  | 'api-error'
  | 'empty-reply'
  | 'aborted'
  | 'turned-off'

export type WarmerState = {
  isEnabled: boolean
  isTurnRunning: boolean
  isPinging: boolean
  // When the main thread's cache was last read or written, by a turn or a ping.
  lastCacheTouchMs: number | null
  pingCount: number
  // Input-token equivalents spent on pings since the last turn.
  pingSpendInputTokens: number
  // The last main-thread request's window, from the session's usage.
  contextTokens: number
  // Cache read price as a multiple of the session model's input price.
  readRate: number
  stopReason: StopReason | null
  ttl: CacheTtl
}
